clues.hard: Which researcher spent years at the University of Pennsylvania studying how nucleoside modifications can reduce unwanted immune responses to mRNA?

fact: Her work helped make therapeutic mRNA more practical.

name: Mary Anning

clues.easy: Which English fossil hunter made important discoveries of ichthyosaurs and plesiosaurs on Dorset’s Jurassic Coast?

fact: Her discoveries helped transform understanding of prehistoric life despite the barriers women faced in nineteenth-century science.
